requirements.text: Signals whose names end in _x shall exist once per data lane, and every signal shall be active High unless its description states otherwise.
requirements.source_quote: Signal names ending in `_x` exist once per data lane. Unless stated otherwise, signals are active High.

requirements.text: ftel_dphy_rx shall be the digital controller of the D-PHY receiver, placed after the AFE and before the CSI-2 Rx controller, and shall present the received lanes to the controller on the PPI.
requirements.source_quote: `ftel_dphy_rx` is the digital controller of a MIPI D-PHY receiver.

requirements.text: The AFE (analog, outside this IP) shall receive the HS and LP line levels and provide termination and deserialization; its exact boundary with this IP is open (ADR-001).
requirements.source_quote: | AFE | Receiving chip, at the pins | Receives the analog line levels

requirements.text: ftel_dphy_rx shall deliver the received data and lane status (rxbyteclkhs, rxdatahs_x, rxvalidhs_x, rxactivehs_x, rxsynchs_x, rxskewcalhs_x, Stop/ULPS/trigger/error indications, init_done) from the AFE to the CSI-2 Rx controller, as inputs of the controller in HAS-CSI Table 4-3.
requirements.source_quote: | Received data and lane status | AFE → `ftel_dphy_rx` → CSI-2 Rx controller |

requirements.text: ftel_dphy_rx shall receive the link-control signals cl_enable, dl_enable_x, forcerxmode_x and phy_core_rst from the CSI-2 Rx controller, which drives them from its CSR (HAS-CSI Table 4-3).
requirements.source_quote: | Link control | CSI-2 Rx controller → `ftel_dphy_rx` | `cl_enable`, `dl_enable_x`, `forcerxmode_x`, `phy_core_rst` |

requirements.text: ftel_dphy_rx shall drive the AFE controls HS-RX enable, termination enable and delay taps as defined in §5.2.
requirements.source_quote: | AFE control | `ftel_dphy_rx` → AFE | HS-RX enable, termination enable, delay taps | §5.2 |

requirements.text: ftel_dphy_rx shall take core_clk (200 MHz) from the system as its reference clock (HAS-CSI Table 4-1).
requirements.source_quote: | Reference clock | System → `ftel_dphy_rx` | `core_clk` (200 MHz) | HAS-CSI Table 4-1 **[CSI]** |

requirements.text: The timer values, lane map and polarity shall be configured over a configuration bus whose definition is open (K3).
requirements.source_quote: | Timer configuration | Configuration bus → `ftel_dphy_rx` | Timer values, lane map, polarity | §4.10, OPEN K3 |

requirements.text: D-PHY behaviour shall follow D-PHY v1.1; the only D-PHY v1.2 feature required is the deskew calibration above 1.5 Gb/s, and every v1.2 item is a documented design decision because the v1.2 specification is not available (ADR-004).
requirements.source_quote: D-PHY behaviour follows D-PHY v1.1 ✅. The only D-PHY v1.2 feature needed is the deskew calibration, required above 1.5 Gb/s **[CSI]** §7.1.

requirements.text: The release plan (R1 without deskew calibration, R2 with calibration) is a proposal pending K1; the target line rate per release must be confirmed by the CSI team.
requirements.source_quote: **Release plan (proposed, OPEN K1).**

requirements.text: Release R1 shall support 80-1500 Mb/s per lane, detect deskew bursts and flag them on rxskewcalhs_x, without deskew calibration.
requirements.source_quote: | R1 | 80–1500 Mb/s | Deskew burst **detected** and flagged on `rxskewcalhs_x`; no calibration |

requirements.text: Release R2 shall support 80-1792 Mb/s per lane with deskew calibration active (Block No. 5) for 4K staggered HDR RAW12.
requirements.source_quote: | R2 | 80–1792 Mb/s | Calibration active (Block No. 5) | 4K staggered HDR RAW12 **[CSI]** §7.3 |

requirements.text: The IP shall support one clock lane and 1, 2 or 4 data lanes, with PARA_NUM_LANES = 4 by default.
requirements.source_quote: One clock lane and 1, 2 or 4 data lanes (`PARA_NUM_LANES` = 4) **[CSI]** C2.

requirements.text: The PPI shall carry an 8-bit data path per lane, all lanes on one shared rxbyteclkhs equal to the HS DDR clock divided by 8.
requirements.source_quote: PPI with an 8-bit data path per lane on one shared `rxbyteclkhs` = HS DDR clock / 8 **[CSI]** C3.

requirements.text: The clock lane shall support HS entry and exit, continuous-clock operation (mandatory) and clock-lane ULPS; the clock-lane FSM shall also handle LP entry between bursts, while the system uses continuous clock in R1.
requirements.source_quote: Clock lane: HS entry and exit, continuous-clock operation (mandatory, CSI-2 §7.1 ✅), and

requirements.text: Each data lane shall support SoT/EoT, sync detection tolerant to a single-bit error, trailer removal, and escape mode with ULPS and Triggers.
requirements.source_quote: Data lanes: SoT/EoT (D-PHY §6.4 ✅), sync detection with single-bit error tolerance, trailer

requirements.text: Low-Power Data Transmission (LPDT) reception shall not be part of R1; the treatment of the LPDT PPI ports is pending K2.
requirements.source_quote: (LPDT) is not in R1 (OPEN K2).

requirements.text: The IP shall indicate SoT error, SoT sync error, escape entry error and false control error, and shall report EoT sync error as a status.
requirements.source_quote: Error indications: SoT error, SoT sync error, escape entry error, false control error (D-PHY

requirements.text: An HS RX timeout shall guarantee that rxactivehs_x always falls, because the CSI-2 controller has no timeout of its own.
requirements.source_quote: An HS RX timeout guarantees that `rxactivehs_x` always falls, because the CSI-2 controller has no timeout of its own **[CSI]** C11.

requirements.text: The IP shall provide TINIT detection with init_done, accept the reset request phy_core_rst, per-lane enables and forcerxmode_x.
requirements.source_quote: Initialization: TINIT detection and `init_done`, reset request `phy_core_rst`, per-lane enables, `forcerxmode_x` **[CSI]** C14, C16.

requirements.text: Receiver timing (THS-SETTLE, TCLK-SETTLE, TINIT, timeouts) shall be programmable and counted in core_clk (200 MHz) cycles.
requirements.source_quote: Programmable receiver timing (THS-SETTLE, TCLK-SETTLE, TINIT, timeouts), counted in `core_clk` (200 MHz) **[CSI]** C15.

requirements.text: The IP shall never parse byte content; the CSI-2 protocol layer (packet header, ECC, CRC, pixel unpacking) stays in the CSI-2 Rx controller.
requirements.source_quote: The CSI-2 protocol layer (packet header, ECC, CRC, pixel unpacking) is in the CSI-2 Rx controller; this IP never parses byte content.

requirements.text: The IP is a unidirectional slave: reverse direction, bus turnaround and 8b9b coding shall not be supported.
requirements.source_quote: are not supported (unidirectional slave per CSI-2 §7.1 ✅).

requirements.text: Block No. 1 (AFE Adapter) shall exist per lane and for the clock lane, with its LP path in core_clk and its HS path in rxbyteclkhs.
requirements.source_quote: | No.1 | AFE Adapter | per lane + clock lane | `core_clk` (LP path), `rxbyteclkhs` (HS path) | R1 |

requirements.text: Block No. 5 (Deskew Controller) shall exist per data lane in the rxbyteclkhs domain and only from release R2.
requirements.source_quote: | No.5 | Deskew Controller | per data lane | `rxbyteclkhs` | R2 |

requirements.text: Block No. 7 (PPI Output Stage) shall drive the HS PPI signals in rxbyteclkhs and the LP PPI signals asynchronously.
requirements.source_quote: | No.7 | PPI Output Stage | 1 | `rxbyteclkhs` (HS signals), asynchronous (LP signals) | R1 |

requirements.text: Block No. 8 (Configuration & Status) shall run in a configuration clock whose source depends on the open configuration path (K3).
requirements.source_quote: | No.8 | Configuration & Status | 1 | configuration clock (OPEN K3) | R1 |

requirements.text: PARA_NUM_LANES (default 4) shall set the number of data lane slices instantiated to 1, 2 or 4; lanes shall be enabled at run time by dl_enable_x.
requirements.source_quote: | 1 | `PARA_NUM_LANES` | 4 | Configurable | Data lane slices instantiated: 1, 2 or 4 **[CSI]** C2. Lanes are enabled at run time by `dl_enable_x` |

requirements.text: PARA_DESER_RATIO shall be fixed at 8 and shall set the width of the AFE word per lane and of rxdatahs_x; it stays a parameter so that a 1:16 AFE can be supported later.
requirements.source_quote: | 2 | `PARA_DESER_RATIO` | 8 | Fixed | Width of the AFE word per lane and of `rxdatahs_x` **[CSI]** C3.

requirements.text: PARA_CORE_CLK_MHZ shall be fixed at 200; it is the reference of every timer, giving a 5 ns resolution.
requirements.source_quote: | 3 | `PARA_CORE_CLK_MHZ` | 200 | Fixed | Reference clock of all timers **[CSI]** C15; resolution 5 ns |

requirements.text: PARA_DESKEW_EN (0 in R1, 1 in R2) shall instantiate Block No. 5; with PARA_DESKEW_EN = 0 deskew bursts shall still be detected by Block No. 4.
requirements.source_quote: | 4 | `PARA_DESKEW_EN` | 0 (R1), 1 (R2) | Configurable | Instantiates Block No. 5. When 0, deskew bursts are still detected (Block No. 4) |

requirements.text: PARA_LPDT_EN (default 0) shall instantiate LPDT reception; when 0 the LPDT PPI outputs shall be tied inactive. The default is pending K2.
requirements.source_quote: | 5 | `PARA_LPDT_EN` | 0 | Configurable | Instantiates LPDT reception. When 0, LPDT PPI outputs are tied inactive (OPEN K2) |

requirements.text: PARA_LP_SYNC_STAGES shall be fixed at 2 and shall set the synchronizer depth of the LP-RX inputs into core_clk.
requirements.source_quote: | 6 | `PARA_LP_SYNC_STAGES` | 2 | Fixed | Synchronizer depth of the LP-RX inputs into `core_clk` |

requirements.text: PARA_LP_FILTER_CYC (default 2, assumption) shall set the LP-state glitch filter length in core_clk cycles, bounded by the termination-enable budget of Appendix B and by the maximum LP glitch width passed by the AFE (open with ADR-001).
requirements.source_quote: | 7 | `PARA_LP_FILTER_CYC` | 2 ⚠️ | Configurable | Glitch filter on LP states, in `core_clk` cycles.

requirements.text: PARA_EOT_DELAY_BYTES (default 32, assumption) shall size the EoT delay line of Block No. 4 to cover THS-TRAIL + THS-SKIP + LP-11 detection latency at the highest line rate; the value depends on the Tx timing table (S5).
requirements.source_quote: | 8 | `PARA_EOT_DELAY_BYTES` | 32 ⚠️ | Configurable | Depth of the EoT delay line (Block No. 4).

requirements.text: PARA_SYNC_SEARCH_BYTES (default 16, assumption) shall bound the byte clocks searched for the sync sequence before errsotsynchs_x is raised, counted from the first non-zero word after the HS entry signal.
requirements.source_quote: | 9 | `PARA_SYNC_SEARCH_BYTES` | 16 ⚠️ | Configurable | Byte clocks searched for the sync sequence before `errsotsynchs_x` is raised, counted from the first non-zero word after the HS entry signal ⚠️ (§4.6) |

requirements.text: PARA_DLY_TAP_WIDTH shall set the width of the AFE delay-tap control used by deskew calibration; its value is still to be determined with ADR-004.
requirements.source_quote: | 10 | `PARA_DLY_TAP_WIDTH` | To be determined | Configurable | Width of the AFE delay-tap control (R2, ADR-004) |

requirements.text: hs_settle_cyc shall default to 20 core_clk cycles (assumption): centre of the THS-SETTLE window at 1500 Mb/s minus the LP detection latency.
requirements.source_quote: | `hs_settle_cyc` | 20 ⚠️ | Centre of the THS-SETTLE window at 1500 Mb/s (89–151.7 ns → ~120 ns) minus LP detection latency (~20 ns).

requirements.text: Software shall program hs_settle_cyc with the Appendix B value for the line rate before enabling the lanes.
requirements.source_quote: Rate dependent: software programs the value of Appendix B for the line rate before enabling the lanes ⚠️

requirements.text: clk_settle_cyc shall default to 36 core_clk cycles (assumption): centre of TCLK-SETTLE minus the LP detection latency, counted from entry into CL_HS_TERM.
requirements.source_quote: | `clk_settle_cyc` | 36 ⚠️ | Centre of TCLK-SETTLE (95–300 ns → ~200 ns) minus the LP detection latency (~20 ns); counted from entry into CL_HS_TERM |

requirements.text: tinit_cyc shall default to 20 000 core_clk cycles so that TINIT,SLAVE >= 100 us is met.
requirements.source_quote: | `tinit_cyc` | 20 000 | TINIT,SLAVE ≥ 100 µs (D-PHY §6.11 ✅) |

requirements.text: hs_rx_timeout_cyc shall default to 2^18 core_clk cycles (1.31 ms, assumption), longer than the longest burst per lane; the longest burst is open (K8).
requirements.source_quote: | `hs_rx_timeout_cyc` | 2^18 (1.31 ms) ⚠️ | Longer than the longest burst: 5802-byte line at 80 Mb/s on one lane ≈ 580 µs; the longest burst per lane is OPEN K8 |

requirements.text: esc_timeout_cyc shall default to 2^18 core_clk cycles (assumption) as the escape-mode watchdog, with the scope and expiry behaviour of §4.7.
requirements.source_quote: | `esc_timeout_cyc` | 2^18 ⚠️ | Escape-mode watchdog (D-PHY §7.3.3 ✅, informative); scope and expiry in §4.7 |

requirements.text: core_clk shall be a free-running 200 MHz system clock that runs all LP-state, escape and timer logic of Blocks No. 1 (LP path), 2, 3 and 6; escape reception shall be done by oversampling.
requirements.source_quote: | `core_clk` | System, free-running **[CSI]** | 200 MHz | Blocks No. 1 (LP path), 2, 3, 6 | All LP-state, escape and timer logic. Escape reception is by oversampling (ADR-002) |

requirements.text: rxbyteclkhs shall be the clock-lane DDR clock divided by 8 from the AFE (187.5 MHz at 1500 Mb/s, 224 MHz at 1792 Mb/s), clock the HS path of Blocks No. 1, 4, 5 and 7, run only while the clock lane is in HS, and be forwarded to the PPI.
requirements.source_quote: | `rxbyteclkhs` | AFE: clock-lane DDR clock / 8 | Line rate / 8; 187.5 MHz at 1500 Mb/s, 224 MHz at 1792 Mb/s | Blocks No. 1 (HS path), 4, 5, 7 |

requirements.text: Block No. 8 shall use a configuration clock whose source and frequency depend on the configuration path (ADR-005, K3).
requirements.source_quote: | configuration clock | System | To be determined | Block No. 8 | Depends on ADR-005 (OPEN K3) |

requirements.text: The asynchronous AFE LP-RX outputs afe_lp_dp_x, afe_lp_dn_x, afe_cl_lp_dp and afe_cl_lp_dn shall enter core_clk through PARA_LP_SYNC_STAGES flip-flops followed by a PARA_LP_FILTER_CYC glitch filter.
requirements.source_quote: | AFE LP-RX (asynchronous) → `core_clk` | `afe_lp_dp_x`, `afe_lp_dn_x`, `afe_cl_lp_dp`, `afe_cl_lp_dn` | `PARA_LP_SYNC_STAGES` flip-flops + `PARA_LP_FILTER_CYC` glitch filter |

requirements.text: HS entry, settle done and EoT request (Block No. 3 to No. 4) shall cross from core_clk to rxbyteclkhs as level signals through 2-flop synchronizers, and the receiving logic shall return to idle when the byte clock stops.
requirements.source_quote: | `core_clk` → `rxbyteclkhs` | HS entry, settle done, EoT request (Block No. 3 → No. 4) | Level signals through 2-flop synchronizers.

requirements.text: EoT done and the error events for status counters shall cross from rxbyteclkhs to core_clk through toggle synchronizers.
requirements.source_quote: | `rxbyteclkhs` → `core_clk` | EoT done, error events for status counters | Toggle synchronizers |

requirements.text: cl_enable, dl_enable_x and forcerxmode_x (lite_aclk domain of the controller) shall enter core_clk as level signals through 2-flop synchronizers.
requirements.source_quote: | Enables (`lite_aclk`) → `core_clk` | `cl_enable`, `dl_enable_x`, `forcerxmode_x` | Level, 2-flop synchronizers; the PPI defines them as level sensitive **[CSI]** C14 |

requirements.text: Timer values, lane map and polarity (configuration clock) shall be treated as quasi-static into core_clk and rxbyteclkhs; software shall change them only while the affected lanes are disabled.
requirements.source_quote: | Configuration clock → `core_clk` / `rxbyteclkhs` | Timer values, lane map, polarity | Quasi-static: software changes them only while the affected lanes are disabled |

requirements.text: The synchronized lane enables shall gate the rxbyteclkhs-domain PPI outputs combinationally at the output stage; an enable shall change only while its lane is in Stop state or the byte clock is stopped.
requirements.source_quote: | `core_clk` → PPI outputs of the `rxbyteclkhs` domain | Synchronized lane enables | Combinational gating at the output stage (§4.9) ⚠️;

requirements.text: phy_core_rst shall reset the whole IP (asynchronous assert, synchronous release per domain), be asserted for at least 40 core_clk cycles by the CSI-2 controller, and restart initialization of every lane on release; its polarity and synchronicity are pending K6 (draft: active High, asynchronous).
requirements.source_quote: | `phy_core_rst` | Input, asynchronous assert, synchronous release per domain | Whole IP |

requirements.text: When cl_enable or dl_enable_x is Low the lane shall be shut down: AFE enables off, lane FSM held in reset, and the PPI outputs of the lane at their inactive values.
requirements.source_quote: | `cl_enable`, `dl_enable_x` | Input, level | One lane | Low: the lane is shut down — AFE enables off, lane FSM held in reset, PPI outputs of the lane at their inactive values (D-PHY Annex A "Enable" ✅) |

requirements.text: When forcerxmode_x is High the data-lane FSM shall return immediately to the wait-for-Stop state and re-initialize; the controller uses it only while the lane is in Stop state.
requirements.source_quote: | `forcerxmode_x` | Input, level | One data lane | High: the lane FSM returns to the wait-for-Stop state immediately and re-initializes (D-PHY Annex A ✅).

requirements.text: Block No. 1 shall isolate the rest of the IP from the AFE, so that it is the only block that changes when the AFE changes.
requirements.source_quote: **Overview.** Isolates the rest of the IP from the AFE (V5 of the research plan). It is the only

requirements.text: The LP path of Block No. 1 shall synchronize and filter the LP-RX outputs into core_clk and present one of LP-11, LP-10, LP-01, LP-00 per lane.
requirements.source_quote: LP path: synchronizes and filters the LP-RX outputs into `core_clk` and presents one of LP-11,

requirements.text: The HS path of Block No. 1 shall register the raw deserialized word of each lane on rxbyteclkhs and apply optional P/N polarity inversion and logical-to-physical lane mapping from configuration fields.
requirements.source_quote: HS path: registers the raw deserialized word of each lane on `rxbyteclkhs`; applies optional

requirements.text: Block No. 1 shall apply the same P/N polarity inversion (Dp/Dn swapped before LP decoding) and the same lane mapping to the LP path as to the HS path, from the same configuration fields.
requirements.source_quote: The same P/N polarity inversion (Dp/Dn swapped before LP decoding) and the same lane mapping apply to the LP path, from the same configuration fields ⚠️.

requirements.text: Block No. 1 shall drive the AFE controls requested by Blocks No. 2, 3 and 5: HS-RX enable, termination enable and delay taps (R2).
requirements.source_quote: Drives the AFE controls requested by Blocks No. 2, 3 and 5: HS-RX enable, termination enable, delay taps (R2).

requirements.text: The FSM outputs hs_en_x, term_en_x, cl_hs_en and cl_term_en shall be internal requests that Block No. 1 drives to the AFE ports afe_* of §5.2.
requirements.source_quote: The FSM outputs `hs_en_x`, `term_en_x`, `cl_hs_en` and `cl_term_en` are internal requests; this block drives them to the AFE ports `afe_*` of §5.2.

requirements.text: The termination enable shall be issued on LP-00 detection without an extra timer so that TD-TERM-EN (<= 35 ns + 4 UI) and TCLK-TERM-EN (<= 38 ns) are met with the ~20 ns digital latency; if the AFE cannot meet the remaining budget, termination switching moves into the AFE (ADR-001).
requirements.source_quote: TD-TERM-EN (≤ 35 ns + 4·UI) and TCLK-TERM-EN (≤ 38 ns) are measured from the

requirements.text: Block No. 2 shall implement the CIL-SCNN function of the clock lane: HS entry and exit (D-PHY v1.1 §6.7, Tables 11-12) and clock-lane ULPS (D-PHY v1.1 §6.8, Table 13).
requirements.source_quote: Implements CIL-SCNN: clock-lane HS entry/exit (D-PHY §6.7, Table 11–12 ✅) and clock-lane ULPS (D-PHY §6.8, Table 13 ✅).

requirements.text: In CL_INIT the clock-lane FSM shall ignore line states until LP-11 has been held for tinit_cyc core_clk cycles, then enter CL_STOP; no PPI output is asserted in CL_INIT.
requirements.source_quote: | CL_INIT | any | LP-11 held for `tinit_cyc` → CL_STOP | — |

requirements.text: In CL_STOP (LP-11) the FSM shall assert cl_stopstate = 1 and move to CL_HS_RQST on LP-01 or to CL_ULPS_RQST on LP-10.
requirements.source_quote: | CL_STOP | LP-11 | LP-01 → CL_HS_RQST; LP-10 → CL_ULPS_RQST | `cl_stopstate` = 1 |

requirements.text: In CL_HS_RQST (LP-01) the clock-lane FSM shall move to CL_HS_PRPR on LP-00 and to CL_STOP on LP-11; on LP-10 it shall treat the request as aborted, wait for LP-11 and then enter CL_STOP, setting a status flag without a PPI error.
requirements.source_quote: | CL_HS_RQST | LP-01 | LP-00 → CL_HS_PRPR; LP-11 → CL_STOP; LP-10 → aborted request: wait for LP-11, then CL_STOP, with a status flag and no PPI error ⚠️ | — |

requirements.text: In CL_HS_PRPR (LP-00) the FSM shall assert cl_term_en = 1 and move to CL_HS_TERM once the termination enable has been issued.
requirements.source_quote: | CL_HS_PRPR | LP-00 | termination enable issued → CL_HS_TERM | `cl_term_en` = 1 |
requirements.notes: Termination timing budget (TCLK-TERM-EN) is the ⚠️ design note of §4.3.

requirements.text: In CL_HS_TERM the FSM shall assert cl_hs_en = 1 and move to CL_HS_CLK after clk_settle_cyc core_clk cycles.
requirements.source_quote: | CL_HS_TERM | LP-00 → HS | `clk_settle_cyc` elapsed → CL_HS_CLK | `cl_hs_en` = 1 |

requirements.text: In CL_HS_CLK the FSM shall assert cl_rxclkactivehs = 1 while the HS clock is received, and move to CL_HS_END when clock activity is lost (TCLK-MISS).
requirements.source_quote: | CL_HS_CLK | HS clock | clock activity lost (TCLK-MISS) → CL_HS_END | `cl_rxclkactivehs` = 1 |
requirements.notes: How clock loss is detected depends on the design note below (AFE detector, ADR-001).

requirements.text: In CL_HS_END the FSM shall keep HS-RX disabled and return to CL_STOP on LP-11.
requirements.source_quote: | CL_HS_END | HS-0 / trail | LP-11 → CL_STOP | HS-RX disabled |

requirements.text: In CL_ULPS_RQST (LP-10) the FSM shall move to CL_ULPS on LP-00 and abort to CL_STOP on LP-01 or LP-11.
requirements.source_quote: | CL_ULPS_RQST | LP-10 | LP-00 → CL_ULPS; LP-01 or LP-11 → abort to CL_STOP | — |

requirements.text: In CL_ULPS (LP-00) the FSM shall drive cl_ulpsclknot = 0 and cl_ulpsactivenot = 0, and move to CL_ULPS_EXIT on LP-10 (Mark-1).
requirements.source_quote: | CL_ULPS | LP-00 | LP-10 (Mark-1) → CL_ULPS_EXIT | `cl_ulpsclknot` = 0, `cl_ulpsactivenot` = 0 |

requirements.text: In CL_ULPS_EXIT (LP-10) the FSM shall drive cl_ulpsclknot = 0 and cl_ulpsactivenot = 1, and return to CL_STOP on LP-11.
requirements.source_quote: | CL_ULPS_EXIT | LP-10 | LP-11 → CL_STOP | `cl_ulpsclknot` = 0, `cl_ulpsactivenot` = 1 **[CSI]** |

requirements.text: Loss of the HS clock shall be detected within TCLK-MISS (<= 60 ns) at every supported rate; because rxbyteclkhs alone cannot do this at 80 Mb/s, clock-activity detection is expected from the AFE (afe_cl_clk_active) or the requirement is relaxed for low rates, to be decided with ADR-001.
requirements.source_quote: At 80 Mb/s the byte clock period is 100 ns, so the loss of the clock cannot be detected within 60 ns from `rxbyteclkhs` alone.

requirements.text: Block No. 3 shall implement CIL-SFEN: the Control-mode FSM of a unidirectional slave data lane, HS entry, EoT hand-over and escape mode.
requirements.source_quote: **Overview.** Implements CIL-SFEN: the Control-mode FSM of a unidirectional slave data lane, HS

requirements.text: In DL_INIT the data-lane FSM shall ignore line states until LP-11 has been held for tinit_cyc core_clk cycles, then enter DL_STOP.
requirements.source_quote: | DL_INIT | any | LP-11 held for `tinit_cyc` → DL_STOP | — |

requirements.text: In DL_STOP (LP-11) the FSM shall assert stopstate_x = 1 and move to DL_HS_RQST on LP-01 or to DL_LP_RQST on LP-10.
requirements.source_quote: | DL_STOP | LP-11 | LP-01 → DL_HS_RQST; LP-10 → DL_LP_RQST | `stopstate_x` = 1 |

requirements.text: In DL_HS_RQST (LP-01) the FSM shall move to DL_HS_PRPR on LP-00 and to DL_ERR on any other line state.
requirements.source_quote: | DL_HS_RQST | LP-01 | LP-00 → DL_HS_PRPR; other → DL_ERR | — |

requirements.text: In DL_HS_PRPR (LP-00) the FSM shall assert term_en_x = 1 and move to DL_HS_TERM once the termination enable has been issued.
requirements.source_quote: | DL_HS_PRPR | LP-00 | termination enable issued → DL_HS_TERM | `term_en_x` = 1 |

requirements.text: In DL_HS_TERM the FSM shall assert hs_en_x = 1 and move to DL_HS_RX after hs_settle_cyc core_clk cycles.
requirements.source_quote: | DL_HS_TERM | LP-00 → HS | `hs_settle_cyc` elapsed → DL_HS_RX | `hs_en_x` = 1 |

requirements.text: In DL_HS_RX Block No. 4 shall be active; the FSM shall move to DL_HS_EOT on LP-11, or after hs_rx_timeout_cyc with a timeout status.
requirements.source_quote: | DL_HS_RX | HS | LP-11 → DL_HS_EOT; `hs_rx_timeout_cyc` elapsed → DL_HS_EOT (timeout status) | Block No. 4 active |

requirements.text: In DL_HS_EOT the FSM shall send the EoT request to Block No. 4 and move to DL_STOP when Block No. 4 reports EoT done.
requirements.source_quote: | DL_HS_EOT | LP-11 | Block No. 4 reports EoT done → DL_STOP | EoT request to Block No. 4 |

requirements.text: In DL_LP_RQST (LP-10) the FSM shall move to DL_LP_YIELD on LP-00 and to DL_ERR on LP-11.
requirements.source_quote: | DL_LP_RQST | LP-10 | LP-00 → DL_LP_YIELD; LP-11 → DL_ERR | — |

requirements.text: In DL_LP_YIELD (LP-00) the FSM shall move to DL_ESC_RQST on LP-01; a turnaround request (LP-10) is not supported and shall lead to DL_ERR.
requirements.source_quote: | DL_LP_YIELD | LP-00 | LP-01 → DL_ESC_RQST; LP-10 → turnaround request, not supported → DL_ERR | — |

requirements.text: In DL_ESC_RQST (LP-01) the FSM shall move to DL_ESC_GO on LP-00 and to DL_ERR on any other line state.
requirements.source_quote: | DL_ESC_RQST | LP-01 | LP-00 → DL_ESC_GO; other → DL_ERR | — |

requirements.text: In DL_ESC_GO (LP-00) the FSM shall move to DL_ESC_CMD on the first Mark.
requirements.source_quote: | DL_ESC_GO | LP-00 | first Mark → DL_ESC_CMD | — |

requirements.text: In DL_ESC_CMD the FSM shall decode 8 Spaced-One-Hot bits: ULPS 00011110 leads to DL_ULPS, a Trigger to DL_ESC_WAIT, LPDT 11100001 to DL_ESC_WAIT with erresc_x in R1, and an unknown command to DL_ESC_WAIT with erresc_x.
requirements.source_quote: | DL_ESC_CMD | Spaced-One-Hot | 8 bits decoded (Table 8 ✅): ULPS `00011110` → DL_ULPS; Trigger → DL_ESC_WAIT;

requirements.text: In DL_ULPS (LP-00) the FSM shall drive rxulpsesc_x = 1 and ulpsactivenot_x = 0, and move to DL_ULPS_EXIT on LP-10 (Mark-1).
requirements.source_quote: | DL_ULPS | LP-00 | LP-10 (Mark-1) → DL_ULPS_EXIT | `rxulpsesc_x` = 1, `ulpsactivenot_x` = 0 |

requirements.text: In DL_ULPS_EXIT (LP-10) the FSM shall drive rxulpsesc_x = 1 and ulpsactivenot_x = 1, and return to DL_STOP on LP-11.
requirements.source_quote: | DL_ULPS_EXIT | LP-10 | LP-11 → DL_STOP | `rxulpsesc_x` = 1, `ulpsactivenot_x` = 1 **[CSI]** |

requirements.text: In DL_ESC_WAIT the FSM shall hold the received trigger bit on rxtriggeresc_x until the lane returns to Stop, and move to DL_STOP on LP-11.
requirements.source_quote: | DL_ESC_WAIT | any | LP-11 → DL_STOP | Trigger bit held on `rxtriggeresc_x` until Stop (Annex A ✅) |

requirements.text: In DL_ERR the FSM shall hold errcontrol_x until the next line-state change and return to DL_STOP on LP-11.
requirements.source_quote: | DL_ERR | any | LP-11 → DL_STOP | `errcontrol_x` held until the next line-state change **[CSI]** C13 |

requirements.text: Every data-lane state shall return to DL_STOP on LP-11, subject to the precedence rule for rows that lead to DL_ERR.
requirements.source_quote: Any state returns to DL_STOP on LP-11 (Table 9, "Any RX state" ✅).

requirements.text: Where a data-lane FSM row names LP-11 or 'other' as a path to DL_ERR (DL_HS_RQST, DL_LP_RQST, DL_ESC_RQST), that row shall take precedence over the global LP-11 rule: the lane passes through DL_ERR, raising errcontrol_x, and then returns to DL_STOP.
requirements.source_quote: "other" as a path to DL_ERR (DL_HS_RQST, DL_LP_RQST, DL_ESC_RQST), that row takes precedence: the lane passes through DL_ERR, raising `errcontrol_x`, and then returns to DL_STOP ⚠️.

requirements.text: The four trigger entry commands of D-PHY Table 8 shall be mapped to rxtriggeresc_x[3:0] in the order of Table 8 (assumption to be confirmed, T1).
requirements.source_quote: The mapping of the four trigger entry commands of Table 8 to `rxtriggeresc_x[3:0]` follows the order of Table 8 ⚠️ (to confirm).

requirements.text: Block No. 4 shall exist per data lane in the rxbyteclkhs domain and turn the raw AFE words into aligned PPI bytes.
requirements.source_quote: **Overview.** Per data lane, in `rxbyteclkhs`. Turns the raw AFE words into aligned PPI bytes.

requirements.text: After the HS entry signal from Block No. 3, Block No. 4 shall compare, every byte clock, a 2-word window of two consecutive AFE words with the leader ...00011101 (first bit received first), accepting any single-bit error.
requirements.source_quote: After the HS entry signal from Block No. 3, compares a 2-word window (two consecutive AFE words, every byte clock) with the leader `…00011101` (first bit received first), accepting any single-bit error (D-PHY §6.4.4 ✅).

requirements.text: The sync search shall last at most PARA_SYNC_SEARCH_BYTES byte clocks counted from the first non-zero word after the HS entry signal, because D-PHY bounds THS-PREPARE + THS-ZERO only from below.
requirements.source_quote: The search lasts at most `PARA_SYNC_SEARCH_BYTES` byte clocks, counted from the first non-zero word after the HS entry signal ⚠️

requirements.text: On an exact sync match the byte offset shall be locked and rxsynchs_x shall pulse in the same rxbyteclkhs cycle as the first payload byte.
requirements.source_quote: Exact match: the byte offset is locked; `rxsynchs_x` pulses in the **same cycle** as the first

requirements.text: On a sync match with a single-bit error the burst shall be received as for an exact match and errsoths_x shall pulse for one cycle.
requirements.source_quote: Single-bit error: as above, plus a one-cycle `errsoths_x` (D-PHY §7.2.1 ✅).

requirements.text: If no sync is found within PARA_SYNC_SEARCH_BYTES, errsotsynchs_x shall pulse for one cycle, rxsynchs_x and rxvalidhs_x shall stay 0 for the rest of the burst, and rxactivehs_x shall stay asserted until EoT.
requirements.source_quote: No match within `PARA_SYNC_SEARCH_BYTES`: one-cycle `errsotsynchs_x`; no `rxsynchs_x` and no

requirements.text: In R1 and R2 a run of at least 16 ones after HS-0 (v1.2 skew-calibration sync) shall assert rxskewcalhs_x until the lane returns to Stop, with no rxvalidhs_x or rxsynchs_x during that burst; in R2 the burst is forwarded to Block No. 5. The exact pattern depends on the Tx deskew behaviour (S4).
requirements.source_quote: **Deskew-burst detection (R1 and R2).** A run of ≥ 16 ones after HS-0 (v1.2 skew-calibration sync,
requirements.notes: The v1.2 deskew pattern comes from a secondary public source (research plan 2.3); S4 must confirm it.

requirements.text: A barrel shifter over two consecutive words shall produce rxdatahs_x with bit 0 received first, and rxvalidhs_x shall be asserted for every aligned byte.
requirements.source_quote: **Byte alignment.** A barrel shifter over two consecutive words produces `rxdatahs_x` with bit 0

requirements.text: Bytes shall pass through a PARA_EOT_DELAY_BYTES delay line; on the EoT request the stored tail shall be scanned backwards, the THS-SKIP bits discarded, the last transition taken as the end of the flipped trailer, and only bytes before it delivered.
requirements.source_quote: **EoT and trailer removal.** Bytes pass through an `PARA_EOT_DELAY_BYTES` delay line.

requirements.text: A last transition that is not on a byte boundary shall raise the EoT sync error status (there is no PPI pin for it).
requirements.source_quote: A last transition that is not on a byte boundary raises the EoT sync error status (D-PHY §7.2.3 ✅; HAS-CSI has no PPI pin for it).

requirements.text: rxactivehs_x shall fall after the last delivered byte of the burst.
requirements.source_quote: `rxactivehs_x` falls after the last byte.

requirements.text: The HS RX timeout of Block No. 3 shall force the same EoT sequence, so that rxactivehs_x always falls.
requirements.source_quote: **Timeout.** The HS RX timeout of Block No. 3 forces the same EoT sequence, so `rxactivehs_x` always falls **[CSI]** C11.

requirements.text: Because the core_clk to byte-clock crossing of the HS entry signal adds 2-3 byte cycles at 80 Mb/s, Block No. 4 shall accept the leader only after at least one all-zero word has been received after the HS entry signal.
requirements.source_quote: The search therefore qualifies the sync on a preceding run of zeros rather than relying only on the settle timer: the leader is accepted only after at least one all-zero word has been received after the HS entry signal ⚠️

requirements.text: Block No. 6 shall hold the programmable timer values and distribute them to Blocks No. 2 and 3.
requirements.source_quote: Holds the programmable timer values and distributes them to Blocks No. 2 and 3.

requirements.text: After phy_core_rst release, enable, or forcerxmode_x, a lane shall ignore all line states until it has observed LP-11 for tinit_cyc.
requirements.source_quote: Initialization (D-PHY §6.11 ✅): after `phy_core_rst` release, enable, or `forcerxmode_x`, a lane ignores all line states until it has observed LP-11 for `tinit_cyc`.

requirements.text: init_done shall rise when the clock lane and every enabled data lane have completed initialization.
requirements.source_quote: `init_done` rises when the clock lane and every enabled data lane have completed initialization **[CSI]** C14, C16.
requirements.notes: Exact init_done semantics are part of K6.

requirements.text: Block No. 6 shall host the HS RX and escape-mode watchdogs.
requirements.source_quote: Hosts the HS RX and escape watchdogs (D-PHY §7.3 ✅).

requirements.text: The escape watchdog shall run only in DL_LP_RQST, DL_LP_YIELD, DL_ESC_RQST, DL_ESC_GO and DL_ESC_CMD, not in DL_ULPS, DL_ULPS_EXIT or DL_ESC_WAIT.
requirements.source_quote: Escape watchdog ⚠️: runs only in DL_LP_RQST, DL_LP_YIELD, DL_ESC_RQST, DL_ESC_GO and DL_ESC_CMD,

requirements.text: On escape-watchdog expiry the data lane shall go to DL_ESC_WAIT, wait for LP-11 without raising a PPI error, and set the escape-timeout sticky flag of Block No. 8.
requirements.source_quote: On expiry the lane goes to DL_ESC_WAIT, which waits for LP-11 without a PPI error, and the escape-timeout sticky flag of Block No. 8 is set.

requirements.text: Block No. 5 shall receive the deskew bursts identified by Block No. 4, drive the AFE delay taps of its lane and select the tap in the centre of the passing window.
requirements.source_quote: Receives deskew bursts identified by Block No. 4, drives the AFE delay taps of its lane, and

requirements.text: The deskew algorithm, tap resolution and use of periodic calibration shall be decided for R2 (ADR-004), once the AFE delay-line capability is known.
requirements.source_quote: The algorithm, the tap resolution and the use of periodic calibration are decided in R2 (ADR-004), once the AFE delay-line capability is known.

requirements.text: RxErrorCalHS shall not be required on the PPI.
requirements.source_quote: RxErrorCalHS is not required **[CSI]** C9.

requirements.text: With PARA_DESKEW_EN = 0, Block No. 5 shall be absent and the AFE delay taps held at their reset value.
requirements.source_quote: With `PARA_DESKEW_EN` = 0 the block is absent and the taps are held at their reset value.

requirements.text: Block No. 7 shall map the internal signals to the PPI names of HAS-CSI Table 4-3, so that a change of the PPI contract stays inside this block.
requirements.source_quote: Maps internal signals to the PPI names of HAS-CSI Table 4-3 (§5.1), so a change of the PPI

requirements.text: Block No. 7 shall force the inactive value of every PPI output of a lane whose enable is Low.
requirements.source_quote: Forces the inactive value of every output of a lane whose enable is Low (D-PHY Annex A ✅).

requirements.text: The rxbyteclkhs-domain PPI outputs shall be gated combinationally with the synchronized lane enable, so their inactive values hold while the byte clock is stopped.
requirements.source_quote: The outputs of the `rxbyteclkhs` domain are gated combinationally with the synchronized enable, so their inactive values hold while the byte clock is stopped ⚠️

requirements.text: Block No. 7 shall generate rxclkesc_x as the XOR of the synchronized LP lines for PPI completeness, and no logic inside the IP shall be clocked by it.
requirements.source_quote: Generates `rxclkesc_x` as the XOR of the synchronized LP lines for PPI completeness; no logic inside this IP is clocked by it (ADR-002).

requirements.text: Block No. 8 shall provide configuration fields for the timer values of §3, lane polarity inversion and lane mapping.
requirements.source_quote: Configuration fields: the timer values of §3, lane polarity inversion and lane mapping (V9), and a

requirements.text: Block No. 8 shall provide a run-time deskew bypass field deskew_bypass (R2), present only when PARA_DESKEW_EN = 1, that holds the delay taps at their reset value.
requirements.source_quote: run-time deskew bypass `deskew_bypass` (R2, present only when `PARA_DESKEW_EN` = 1; holds the taps at their reset value) ⚠️.

requirements.text: Block No. 8 shall report the lane FSM states and sticky flags with counters for EoT sync errors, HS RX timeouts, SoT errors, escape errors, escape timeouts and aborted clock-lane requests.
requirements.source_quote: Status: the lane FSM states, and sticky flags with counters for EoT sync errors, HS RX timeouts, SoT errors, escape errors, escape timeouts and aborted clock-lane requests.

requirements.text: The bus and register map of Block No. 8 are open (K3, ADR-005).
requirements.source_quote: The bus and register map are OPEN (K3, ADR-005); chapter 6.

requirements.text: The PPI signal list and semantics shall follow HAS-CSI Table 4-3, with directions seen from this IP.
requirements.source_quote: Direction is seen from this IP. Signal list and semantics follow HAS-CSI Table 4-3 **[CSI]**.

findings.text: The v0.4 precedence rule sends a lane that sees LP-11 in DL_HS_RQST, DL_LP_RQST or DL_ESC_RQST through DL_ERR and back to DL_STOP on the same LP-11, while DL_ERR holds errcontrol_x 'until the next line-state change' [CSI] C13. The line stays LP-11, so it is not stated whether errcontrol_x stays high while the lane already reports Stop, or for how long.
findings.source_quote: that row takes precedence: the lane passes through DL_ERR, raising `errcontrol_x`, and then returns to DL_STOP ⚠️.
findings.proposed_default: errcontrol_x stays high until the next line-state change after that LP-11 (the next LP-01 or LP-10), per C13, while the lane is already in DL_STOP; confirm with the CSI team that a Stop state with errcontrol_x high is acceptable.
